description.value: South Arm Community Centre is a City of Richmond–operated two-storey community and sports facility in the South Arm neighbourhood. As a municipally run centre, it typically serves the surrounding community with fitness and recreational programming. Touring cyclists passing through Richmond's flat, cycling-friendly streets may find it a convenient stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a City of Richmond–operated community centre and sports centre at 8880 Williams Road. The specific website URL for South Arm Community Centre returned a 404 error; subpages fetched are generic City of Richmond municipal pages with no South Arm–specific content, so no amenity claims can be confirmed from the website. All amenity fields default to null as a result, with the exception of confirmed_open which is set to true based on OSM looks_closed=false and the active City of Richmond municipal domain.
concerns: OSM website URL (https://www.richmond.ca/parksrec/centres/southarmcentre/southarm.htm) returns a 404 — the page has likely moved or been reorganised on the City of Richmond site. URL should be updated.
No amenity details could be confirmed due to the 404; a manual visit or updated URL would be needed to verify bike parking, washrooms, and other cyclist amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, publicly accessible City of Richmond community and sports centre with no indication of closure; the broken URL is a website maintenance issue, not evidence the facility is defunct.

wow_evidence: Municipal community centre — walk-in; wins over the near-identical Community Hall record (79dc42e33b).
